newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria's Assad in talks with Iran's military chief.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Assad in talks with Iran's military chief.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad on Monday met Iranian Defence Minister Mohammad Forouzandeh for talks on military cooperation.
Presidential spokesman Joubran Kourieh said Syrian Defence Minister Lieutenant-General Mustafa Tlas was present at the meeting at the presidential palace in the Syrian capital.

Forouzendeh, who arrived in Damascus on Thursday at the head of a military team, held talks with Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi, Defence Minister Tlas and Lieutenant-General Hikmat Shihabi, chief of staff of the Syrian armed forces.
The Iranian minister expressed support for Syria in its confrontation with Israel during a tour of the Syrian side of the Golan Heights on Friday.

An official said the visit, in response to an invitation by Tlas, was aimed at holding talks on various military issues "but no arms deals or military agreements were discussed in particular during the talks".
Diplomats noted that the Iranian minister's visit came amid increased tension between Israel and militants of the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) in south Lebanon.
It also follows reports that Iran was sending missiles to the Hizbollah fighters through Damascus.
Syria and Iran back Hizbollah whose fighters are waging a war against the Israeli presence in parts of south Lebanon.
Both also support Palestinian fundamentalist groups including Hamas and the Islamic Jihad which claimed several suicide attacks in which scores of Israelis were killed.
Syria, which has had close ties with Tehran since the Islamic revolution in 1979, backed Iran in its war with Iraq between 1980 and 1988.
